description: A streaming chart with a rolling window in Svelte 5. Live data needs no special chart API: the spec is a $derived, so appending a tick to the rows re-runs rowsToChartSpec and re-renders the chart, and capping the array at 60 ticks keeps the last window on screen with older points dropping off the left. Press Start and prices stream at 4 Hz while smoothing, brush and zoom stay available.
keywords: svelte real time chart svelte runes

faq.question: How is the window kept fixed?
faq.answer: After each tick the rows array is sliced to its last 60 entries before being assigned, so the derived spec always covers the same number of points.

faq.question: Does re-aggregating every tick cost much?
faq.answer: Not at this size. rowsToChartSpec over 60 rows is a few microseconds, and the chart re-renders only the paths that changed.

faq.question: Can I keep the grid and chart in sync?
faq.answer: Yes. Both read the same rows array, so the table scrolls the same window the chart draws.
